from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A named party involved in the legal case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the party")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Their procedural role, e.g., '上诉人', '再审申请人', '被执行人'")

class FeeItem(BaseModel):
    """A fee cost detail extracted from the document."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The fee amount, e.g., '3780 元'")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the fee, e.g., '上诉人'")
    description: str | None = Field(description="Additional description of the fee")

class CourtInfo(BaseModel):
    """Court details associated with the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the court")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The case number, e.g., '(2022) 辽 01 执异 782 号'")

class CaseResult(BaseModel):
    """The outcome details of the legal case."""
    summary: str | None = Field(description="Summary of the verdict, e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判'")
    is_final: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this is a final judgment/ruling")
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the document, e.g., '判决文书 1'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="All parties named in the document")
    fee_items: list[FeeItem] = Field(description="Fee details extracted from the document")
    court_info: list[CourtInfo] = Field(description="Court name and case number")
    case_results: list[CaseResult] = Field(description="Verdict summaries and document identifiers")
